sentences.text:
Basireddy Rajeswar Reddy vs The State Of Ap on 16 November,
2023
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh: Amaravati
 Honourable Sri Justice Subba Reddy Satti
 Writ Petition No.29711 of 2023
 Basireddy Rajeswar Reddy, S/o Veera Reddy,
 aged 70 years, Occ: Business, R/o
 D.No.15/902, Modamida Palli Street,
 Proddatur Town, Ysr District.

entities.text: High Court Of Andhra Pradesh: Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
... Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Andhra Pradesh, Rep. by its
 Principal Secretary, Department of Municipal
 Administration, Secretariat, Velagapudi,
 Amaravati, Guntur District and another.

... Respondents
Counsel for the petitioner : Sri I. Koti Reddy
Counsel for respondents : Gp for Municipal
 Administration and
 Urban Development and
 Sri N. Ranga Reddy,
 learned standing counsel

: 
The grievance of the petitioner is that respondent No.2 gave marking to the building bearing door No.15-264, Mydukur Road, Ward No.15, Proddatur Town, YSR District,
SRSJ without issuing any notice and is taking steps to demolish the structure.

2. Heard learned counsel on either side.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that without following the procedure mandated under Section 174 of the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act 1965 (for short the 'Act') or The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
the authorities have attempted to demolish the structures.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Learned standing counsel, on instructions of Commissioner of respondent No.2 would submit that road widening process is being undertaken and the authorities gave markings.

He would further Basireddy Rajeswar Reddy vs The State Of Ap on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117072903/
1 submit that authorities are not demolishing the structure.

entities.text: Basireddy Rajeswar Reddy vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The authority will issue notice and follow due process in accordance with the Act.

5. In view of the instructions of the Commissioner of respondent No.2, this writ petition is disposed of at the stage of admission, directing the Commissioner of respondent No.2 SRSJ to follow the procedure contemplated under the Act, i.e. issuing notice, considering explanation if necessary by providing opportunity of hearing etc., before demolishing the structure door No.15-264, Mydukur Road, Ward No.15, Proddatur Town, YSR District.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
